title: Free and Easy Wandering
lines: In the Northern Ocean there is a fish named Kun.
The Kun is so large that no one knows how many thousand li it is.
It transforms into a bird named Peng.
The Peng's back alone is so large
That no one knows how many thousand li it spans.
When the Peng flies, its wings obscure the sky like clouds.
It journeys to the Southern Ocean, the Celestial Lake.
A cicada and a little dove laugh at the Peng:
"When we fly up, we can reach the elm and the sapanwood tree,
And sometimes we fall short and land on the ground.
Why would anyone fly ninety thousand li to the south?"
Small knowledge cannot reach great knowledge.
A brief life cannot comprehend a long one.
